set.article_title: Tube and pipe bender buying guide
set.article_intro: What we go through with customers before they buy a tube or pipe bender: CLR, D of bend and wall factor, push-type, rotary draw or mandrel bending, when a mandrel is needed, manual, NC or CNC, and tooling. Written by NovoTech's sales engineers and technicians from years of installing machines in Canada.
